command: f=$(grep -rl "class RipgrepLocator" <F3> --include=*.cs); echo "$f"; grep -n "ConfiguredPath" $f | head; awk '/ConfiguredPath\(/{p=1} p{print NR": "$0} p&&/^    }/{exit}' $f
f=$(grep -rl "class RipgrepLocator" . --include='*.cs'); echo "$f"; for x in $f; do grep -n "ConfiguredPath" "$x"; done
